id./param/scenario/cs/b_090_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Oh, human customers are rare. Enjoy roulette to your heart's content. This way...
"Sis, you're up! Do your thing again today!
"Hee hee... Which boy wants to be my prey next...?
"N-No, it can't be...!
"P-Princess!?
"...Oh? Hendrik. Even a stuffed shirt like you comes to places like this.
"Hee hee... You want some excitement too. I'll give you plenty of service, so play with me?
"P-Princess! How shameless...!
"Hendrik, you're so tiresomely serious. Even a dog can be merely loyal.
"Shall I make you my dog? I'll make you the happiest pet in the world.
"How indecent...! What's gotten into you, Jade!? This is no time for jokes!
"We need your power to carry through our conviction to beat Mordegon! Come travel with us again...
"Ugh! Same noisy old man. You're killing the fun mood!
"Listen, I'm not interested in beating Mordegon. This world should be smashed even more.
"I'm only interested in Booga, the Spectral Sentinel who built this casino. My body and heart are Booga's.
"So I won't go with you. I'll stay with Booga and make this casino thrive!
"That's enough, Princess! This is no time for such nonsense!
"A seedy place like this doesn't befit a noble princess! Come with us!
"Don't touch me so casually.
"Don't you know how to invite a woman...? You understand nothing.
"You seem to need a harsh punishment. Persistent types like you, I'll silence with my kicks!"
